purpose: Atomic, evidence-driven criteria for maturity promotion in QF_solver 0.2.1 alpha.

policy.primary_engineering_error_policy: From QF_solver 0.2.1a0 onward, every primary engineering observable used for V&V or stable promotion must have a relative error <= 1 percent against its declared reference. A value > 1 percent blocks stable promotion unless a formal mechanical justification, reproducible additional refinement, and a dated Owner decision are recorded. Residuals, mesh increments and conditioning diagnostics remain separate acceptance criteria.
policy.final_relative_error_policy: From this baseline onward, every primary V&V comparison observable must be <= 1 percent relative error. Stable promotion and closure of a validated scope are blocked when the limit is exceeded, unless a formal mechanical justification, additional convergence study and explicit Owner decision are recorded.
policy.singularity_policy: Point peaks at singularities are informative only and cannot be the sole acceptance observable.
